parameters.name: navmesh
parameters.doc:
The bytes of a Recast navmesh set file, such as
`sys.load_resource` returns.

functions.name: find_path
functions.brief: Finds a path between the points of the mesh nearest to `start` and
functions.description:
Finds a path between the points of the mesh nearest to `start` and
`finish`. When `finish` cannot be reached, the path ends at the
reachable point nearest to it; when no path is found, the table is empty.

parameters.name: straight_path_options
parameters.doc:
Detour `dtStraightPathOptions`: `1` adds a
corner where the path crosses into another area, `2` where it crosses
any polygon edge. Default is `0`.

returnvalues.doc:
The corners of the path, in order. Read them with `get` or
`pairs`: keys start at 0, so this is not an array.
**0️⃣ 0-based; passed to `detour` unchanged.**

functions.name: set_area_cost
functions.brief: Sets the cost of crossing each area. The defaults are `1` for areas 0, 2
functions.description:
Sets the cost of crossing each area. The defaults are `1` for areas 0, 2
and 3, `10` for area 1, `2` for area 4 and `1.5` for area 5.

parameters.name: costs
parameters.doc: Cost per area: `costs[0]` is the cost of area 0.

functions.name: set_include_flags
functions.brief: Sets the polygon flags a path may cross. The default is every flag but
functions.description:
Sets the polygon flags a path may cross. The default is every flag but
`0x10`, which marks disabled polygons.

functions.name: create_crowd
functions.brief: Prepares the mesh's crowd for up to 128 agents. Calling it again resets
functions.description:
Prepares the mesh's crowd for up to 128 agents. Calling it again resets
the same crowd.

parameters.name: max_agent_radius
parameters.doc: Radius of the largest agent the crowd will hold.

functions.name: delete
functions.brief: Frees the mesh and its crowd. Neither can be used after it.
functions.description: Frees the mesh and its crowd. Neither can be used after it.

properties.name: position
properties.brief: Where the corner lies on the mesh.
properties.description: Where the corner lies on the mesh.

properties.name: area
properties.brief: Area id of the polygon the corner lies on.
properties.description: Area id of the polygon the corner lies on.

properties.name: start
properties.brief: `true` on the corner the path starts from.
properties.description: `true` on the corner the path starts from.

properties.name: end
properties.brief: `true` on the corner the path ends at.
properties.description: `true` on the corner the path ends at.

properties.name: offmesh
properties.brief: `true` on a corner that starts an off-mesh connection.
properties.description: `true` on a corner that starts an off-mesh connection.

functions.name: add_agent
functions.brief: Adds an agent at a position on the mesh.
functions.description: Adds an agent at a position on the mesh.

parameters.name: max_acceleration
parameters.doc: Largest change of velocity per second.

parameters.name: update_flags
parameters.doc:
Detour `dtUpdateFlags` to steer with: `1` anticipate
turns, `2` avoid obstacles, `4` keep apart from other agents, `8` optimize
the path by visibility, `16` optimize the path by topology.

returnvalues.doc:
The agent id, or `-1` when the crowd already holds 128 agents.
**0️⃣ 0-based; passed to `detour` unchanged.**

functions.name: remove_agent
functions.brief: Removes an agent from the crowd.
functions.description: Removes an agent from the crowd.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.doc:
Id of the agent, as {@link Crowd.add_agent} returned it.
**0️⃣ 0-based; passed to `detour` unchanged.**

functions.name: set_target
functions.brief: Sends agents toward the point of the mesh nearest to `target`.
functions.description: Sends agents toward the point of the mesh nearest to `target`.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.doc:
Id of the agent to send. When omitted, every active agent
is sent. **0️⃣ 0-based; passed to `detour` unchanged.**

functions.name: reset_target
functions.brief: Stops agents moving toward their target.
functions.description: Stops agents moving toward their target.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.doc:
Id of the agent to stop. When omitted, every agent is
stopped. **0️⃣ 0-based; passed to `detour` unchanged.**

functions.name: update
functions.brief: Moves every agent by one step of the simulation.
functions.description: Moves every agent by one step of the simulation.

returnvalues.doc:
The active agents, keyed by agent id. Read them with `get` or
`pairs`: keys start at 0 and skip inactive agents, so this is not an
array. **0️⃣ 0-based; passed to `detour` unchanged.**

properties.name: position
properties.brief: Where the agent is after the update.
properties.description: Where the agent is after the update.

properties.name: velocity
properties.brief: The agent's velocity after the update.
properties.description: The agent's velocity after the update.

properties.name: state
properties.brief: `"walk"` on the mesh, `"offmesh"` on an off-mesh connection, else `"invalid"`.
properties.description: `"walk"` on the mesh, `"offmesh"` on an off-mesh connection, else `"invalid"`.
